Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000349": As of 2025-04-24, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000114": Cinder owns the indexer.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000108": Team Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000331": In the catalog service, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000329" [decision]: Decision on 2025-04-17: the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000345": The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000180" [preference]: As of 2025-02-06, the Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000321": The catalog service calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the catalog service.  (about: image resizer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000316" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhooks service relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down, the webhooks service is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000341": As of 2025-04-22, the indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000090": As of 2025-01-10, the Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000318": As of 2025-04-07, the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
Existing entity names: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder, indexer, product catalog, catalog service, OpenSearch 2.11, Dune team, notification service, Boreal team, ledger service, notifier, INC-2025-004, Ember team, webhook dispatcher, image resizer, the bus, broker, authentication gateway, Oskar
